desc:
An exciting fast-paced racing game where pure speed won't save you! Choose from dozens of unique abilities to OVERTAKE your opponents, sabotage their drive, and take over the track!

🔥 Compete with other players in 1v1 to 5v5 races!
🥇 When the time is up, the player with the most laps wins!
🔮 Use abilities to boost your speed or cause chaos!
⚡ Earn volts to unlock new karts & abilities!
😎 Show off with unique kart & ability skins!

🎮 Available on PC, Mobile & Console!
👍 Like the game & join the group for exclusive rewards!

⚠️ Exploiters will be permanently banned. We do not appeal our bans.
